meta.overview: Publish a free slot, manage your offers and see what GatVuller earns you.
meta.bookings: Who is coming today, tomorrow and later? Check customers in with the code on their voucher.
meta.payouts: See how Stripe handles your payouts and what your balance is.
meta.settings: Business profile, photos, opening hours, cancellation window and treatment templates.

dashboard.settingsLead: What customers see about your business, and the rules your slots are booked under.
dashboard.scopeAll: The figures add up all {count} of your businesses.

kpi.liveHint: Real payments through Stripe, for appointments that ended in this period.
kpi.testHint: Simulated and Stripe test payments. This is not real money.
kpi.revenueHint: What customers paid for these appointments, refunds excluded.
kpi.netHint: The extra revenue minus GatVuller’s commission.
kpi.filledHint: Paid bookings, including customers who did not turn up.
kpi.hoursHint: The length of every slot at least one customer paid for. Empty time you put to use after all.
kpi.occupancyHint: Spots filled as a share of all the spots you offered in slots that ended.
kpi.occupancyNone: No slots ended in this period.
kpi.noShowsHint: Customers who paid but did not come. They are not refunded.
kpi.upcoming: {count, plural, =0 {No paid bookings for upcoming slots yet.} one {In addition, # paid booking is scheduled ({amount}).} other {In addition, # paid bookings are scheduled ({amount}).}}
kpi.empty: No completed appointments in this period yet.

salonNote.PENDING: We are still checking your business. Once it is approved, you can publish slots.
salonNote.SUSPENDED: Your business is suspended, so nothing is online. Please contact us.
salonNote.payouts: Connect Stripe to put your slots online. Until then, customers cannot see them.

visible.label: Visible to customers
visible.reason: Customers can book this slot right now.

paused.label: Paused
paused.reason: Customers cannot see this offer. Resume it to put it back online.

full.label: Fully booked
full.reason: Every spot is booked. There is nothing left to do.

closing.label: Booking closed
closing.reason: The slot starts in under {minutes} minutes. Customers can no longer book.

ended.label: Ended
ended.reason: This slot is over and no longer online.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.reason: You withdrew this offer. Customers who paid were refunded.

salon_pending.label: Awaiting approval
salon_pending.reason: We are still checking your business. Once it is approved, this offer goes online.

salon_suspended.label: Business suspended
salon_suspended.reason: Your business is suspended, so nothing is online. Please contact us.

payouts_missing.label: Not visible
payouts_missing.reason: Customers will only see this slot once you have connected Stripe.

payments_off.label: Payments are off
payments_off.reason: No payment method is active on GatVuller at the moment, so customers cannot book this slot yet.

demo_hidden.label: Demo business hidden
demo_hidden.reason: A demo business is only online in test mode.

offer.booked: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has booked yet} one {# customer booked} other {# customers booked}}
offer.noOffersBody: Publish your first free slot above. It takes under a minute.

form.intro: Pick a template or enter the title and price. Times are Brussels time.
form.title: Treatment
form.summary: The customer pays {price} instead of {original}. After {fee}% commission you keep about {net}.
form.priceInvalid: Enter an amount, for example 29 or 29.50.

edit.title: Edit offer
edit.locked: There are already bookings. The treatment and prices are fixed, so customers get what they booked. You can change the details and add extra spots.

actions.pauseDone: Paused. Customers no longer see this slot. Existing bookings stay in place.
actions.resumeDone: Resumed. Check the visibility line to see whether customers can see the slot now.
actions.withdrawBody: The slot disappears from the site and customers who already paid are refunded in full. This cannot be undone.
actions.withdrawRefunds: {count, plural, =0 {There was nobody to refund.} one {# customer is being refunded.} other {# customers are being refunded.}}
actions.withdrawFailed: {count, plural, one {# refund failed.} other {# refunds failed.}} We will retry automatically.

bookings.earlierNote: Only the latest {count} past bookings are shown.
bookings.checkinHint: Scan the customer’s QR code or type the code from the voucher.
bookings.notFound: This code does not belong to a booking at your business.
bookings.privacy: You only see the name and code, plus the phone number for upcoming appointments. Email addresses stay hidden.
bookings.cancelConfirm: {name} gets {amount} back and the slot becomes available again. This cannot be undone.
bookings.noShowConfirm: Mark {name} as a no-show? The amount is not refunded.
bookings.emptyBody: As soon as someone books a slot, you will see them here with their name and code.
bookings.loadError: We could not load the bookings.
bookings.loadErrorBody: Please try again. Nothing has been lost.

pay.lead: Customers pay through Stripe. Stripe pays the amount, minus GatVuller’s {percent}% commission, into your account. GatVuller does not store card or bank details.
pay.noStripe: Stripe has not been set up in this environment yet. You can connect Stripe once GatVuller switches it on. Until then, there is nothing for you to do.
pay.testMode: Stripe test mode: no real money is paid out.
pay.demo: This is a demo business. There are no payouts.
pay.noAccount: You do not have a payout account yet. Until Stripe is connected, customers cannot book with you.
pay.loadFailed: The status could not be loaded. Please try again later.
pay.unavailable: You can connect Stripe once GatVuller switches it on.
pay.connectFailed: Stripe cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.

active.label: Active
active.text: Customers can book with you and Stripe pays out to your account.

payoutsOff.label: Payouts not active yet
payoutsOff.text: Customers can pay, but Stripe is not paying anything out yet. Complete the details Stripe asks for.

incomplete.label: Not finished
incomplete.text: Stripe still needs some details before customers can book with you.

restricted.label: Restricted by Stripe
restricted.text: Stripe has restricted your account. Open your Stripe dashboard to see what is needed.

req.identity: An ID document for the business owner
req.person: Personal details of the business owner
req.business: Details about your business, such as address and website

manage.name: Name
manage.profileSaved: Profile saved. A changed address has been placed on the map again.
manage.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, 4 MB at most.
manage.locCreated: Location created. It is awaiting approval.
manage.hoursInvalid: On {day}, the closing time must be after the opening time.
manage.cancelLabel: Free cancellation until (hours before the start)
manage.cancelHint: Applies to new bookings. Existing bookings keep the window they were booked with.
manage.tplRemoveConfirm: Delete this template? Existing offers stay in place.
manage.tplHint: Templates appear as buttons in the form for publishing a free slot.

error.title: The dashboard is not loading
error.body: Something went wrong. Please try again. Nothing has been lost.

errors.geocode_failed: We could not place this address on the map. Check the street, number and city.
errors.price_invalid: The last-minute price must be lower than the normal price.
errors.payment_missing: There is no payment we can refund for this booking. Please contact us.
errors.city_unknown: We do not know this city.
errors.too_many_templates: You can keep 30 templates at most. Delete one first.
